title: Blissful Chinese-Style Breakfast Bowl
description: A twist on traditional Chinese breakfast dishes, this recipe combines the flavors of ackee, umami, and bliss for a nutritious and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Ackee
ingredients.notes: Fresh or canned, drained and rinsed

instructions: Cook the bliss rice according to package instructions or reheat leftover.
In a large saucepan, combine the umami mushroom broth and cooked ackee. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the ackee is tender.
Stir in the soy sauce and sesame oil.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked bliss rice among four bowls.
Top each bowl with the ackee and broth mixture.
Garnish with scallions and serve immediately.
